svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Container architecture
svg.desc: The image build produces a root-owned, read-only toolchain; the dev user runs the wrapper, osf, and the agents, whose hook files all call osf hook.

g.text: AGENT HOOK WIRING · OSF HOOK EVENTS
